If the agent implements the Agent2Agent protocol, it can be used as a connected agent for the agents that users build in Agent Builder or Copilot Studio.</p> (GA: August CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Excel: Get and transform data with Copilot in Excel
item.description: <p>Get your data ready, just by asking. Describe the data you need and how you want it prepared, and the new get data skill handles the rest. It can connect and transform your data, then load the results into your workbook using Power Query, giving you a query you can inspect, edit, and refresh with (GA: October CY2026) — Excel

item.title: Planner: Task History
item.description: <p>Task History helps keep teams up to date on changes made to a task. View recent activity to see what changed, when it changed, and track progress over time.</p> (GA: October CY2026) — Planner

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Hide Organizer name in Calendar View on Teams Panels
item.description: <p>Admins can now choose whether the organizer name will show up in the Calendar View on Teams panels. Admins can toggle the "Show organizer name" setting ON or OFF in the Pro Management portal or on the panel device. Based on the selection, the organizer name will or will not be shown in the calend (GA: October CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Planner: Capacity view
item.description: <p>Capacity view shows a timeline of who's working on what, so you can see how work is distributed across your team and spot overload or open capacity at a glance.</p> (GA: October CY2026) — Planner

item.title: Outlook: Reply with a Template in Rules
item.description: <p>You can now create a rule that automatically replies to incoming messages with a template you've set up. Set the conditions you care about and pick the template, and Outlook handles the response for you. It's a simple way to send consistent replies without typing the same thing over and over. #ne (GA: October CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Outlook: Copilot Chat pop-out for Outlook for Mac and iPad
item.description: <p>Copilot Chat remains accessible within an Outlook app window but now can also be popped out to float over the main Outlook app window. Popping out Copilot Chat allows people to switch contexts or have more space for what they are working on in Outlook and control the space and form that Copilot C (GA: August CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Organize important resources in chats and channels
item.description: <p>Microsoft Teams is introducing a new way to organize and access important resources in chats and channels. Users will be able to pin key content, including links, files, and messages, directly beneath the chat or channel header for quick access. Resources can also be organized into folders, makin (GA: October CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Updated header and dashboard for chats and channels on mobile
item.description: <p>You can now get oriented and take action faster when using Teams on mobile, with a redesigned header and lightweight dashboard that brings key channel details, people, and pinned content into one intuitive place. It creates a more predictable, familiar experience across desktop and mobile so you (GA: October CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars
item.description: <p>Organizers, co-organizers, and presenters can chat privately in a separate chat from attendees. This chat is available to access before, during, and after the event.</p> (GA: October CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: <p>In addition to capturing real-time notes and meeting outcomes during scheduled or hybrid meetings, the Facilitator agent assists you with notes, decisions and actions for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Windows. Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console. Meeting notes appear (GA: October CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365), Microsoft Teams

item.title: Word: Legal plugins in Copilot
item.description: <p>Legal plugins in Copilot provide purpose-built skills to help legal professionals summarize, draft, review, and redline legal documents. Available in Word and Cowork, these plugins can use work context from Microsoft 365 and connect to supported third-party legal sources.</p> (GA: October CY2026) — Word, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Outlook: Send availability in Outlook mobile apps
item.description: <p>We are bringing back send availability on both iOS and Android. iOS users will now also be able to access more of this feature via keyboard and voiceover.</p> (GA: October CY2026) — Outlook
